de: In Makhachkala, a 19-year-old driver without a license knocked down to death a man crossing the roadway outside the pedestrian crossing zone, according to the traffic police…

te: Liverpool won a strong-willed victory over Atletico in the Champions League
de: English "Liverpool" beat the Spanish "Atletico" in the match of the first round of the main stage of the football Champions League.

te: Arsenal defeated Napoli in the Champions League match
